text: KnowledgeFlow.jsx PromotionDialog eligible extend targets for tier==='team' now derive from teamSkills (graph skill nodes) rather than skills.filter(source==='team'), so adopted/promoted global skills visible in the column are selectable; effectiveTo is derived from selectedTarget.scope (not the tier chip) to send the correct to:'global' scope to the backend.

Startup backfill for skill.json lives in admin-console (app.listen callback) only — orchestrator mounts /template-workspace read-only and cannot write to the global pool. Agent-tier skills are stamped lazily on first GET /api/skills or GET /api/skills/:name/content read.

persistKnowledgeSummaries (#635) calls the full runConvergenceCollector (not a lighter write path), mirroring archiveKnowledgeEntry — this means a summary backfill can trigger auto-promotion side effects at autonomy >= 3, which is intentional but surprising if not expected.
